comment.narrative: Evaluation sheets assessing thresher use and performance
2000 by yr4 2023 600 male 400 female. Disaggregated value does not match with global value

Cumulatively 581 smallholder grains and cereal farmers across the five project districts had their productivity improved through the efficient threshing services provided by the ReDIAL Action. Impact assessment surveys confirmed that threshing time for beneficiaries has reduced significantly compared to when they were using other means of threshing. While the ReDIAL multicrop thresher averagely threshed a bag of grain in 10 minutes with an average labor of 5 people using other means of threshing would have taken beneficiaries 125 minutes 2 hours 5 minutes with an average labor of 8 people. This implies that the ReDIAL Action has enhanced the productivity of beneficiaries as threshing time saved could be used for other economic and noneconomic activities.

These include 1 revising the 2013 Ghana Fertilizer Policy 2 developing a national sustainable soil policy to regulate application of inorganic fertilizers and agrochemicals and promote the use of sustainable alternatives like organic fertilizers 3 developing a standard pricing systempolicy for food crops particularly grains and cereals based on weight 4 facilitating the formation of strong unionized cereals and grains farmer groups to lead advocacy 5 fertilizer distribution and management at the local level 6 park land policy to replace free range cattle grazing influenced at district assembly policy making level at Donkokrom and Ejura and 7 standardization of unit of measurement in cereals policy and practice at the TechimanEjura transitional landscape level.
